author: bald and bankrupt
description: 🇨🇿 There is a good chance you have been to the Central European country of Czechia. Millions visit every year. However, of those of you who have visited, how many have been to towns outside of Prague? Well, I felt it was time I did so. Join me and Fred ( Instagram: vostokfsl ) and @BackpackerBen on a journey deep into the country...
title: I Left The UK For This Country...Find Out Why
